items.name: Kit board
items.description: tella.com is captured, then its colours, type, radii and icons are pulled out into a kit board beside the page.

items.name: Opener and lower third
items.description: An opener in tella.com's own layout, with a two-tone headline and a pill button, and the interview playing in the site's frame. It grows into full-screen footage with a lower third in the same style.

items.name: Quote card and end card
items.description: The speaker in a rounded camera card beside a two-tone serif quote, then an end card with the site's buttons and its tab row.

items.name: Second brand (fictional)
items.description: The same pieces cloned from a fictional serif publisher brand, with cream paper, vermilion and hairline rules, which shows the kit is not tied to Tella.
